prompt:
USE: One illustrated element on plain off-white paper, to be cut out and placed on a cover by hand. Artwork only, no lettering.

SUBJECT: Six ravens in flight, spread over the sheet with white space between them, seen from below and from the side in different wing positions, brush and India ink: near-solid black silhouettes with a few white dry-brush lines scratched into the feather edges.

COMPOSITION: Only what the subject names, on even plain paper with white space around it; no scene, no frame, no cast shadow.

BRAND:
Inch of Shadow, a Berlin artist: light and shadow held together in one frame.
Hand-made print look: brush and India ink, dry brush, or old copperplate engraving. Lines, hatching and solid black carry all the shading.
Strong contrast: deep blacks next to clean paper white, a few fine white lines scratched into the black.
Black ink by default; colour only where the subject asks for it, as one loose wash.
Quiet and a little mysterious, tender rather than grim.

CONSTRAINTS:
- No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks.
- No churches, domes, crosses, or other religious symbols.
- No photograph, no 3D render, no digital airbrush or soft gradients.
- Not in the style of any named living artist, and not a copy of any existing cover.
